That's order Shop····, delivered August 10. One thing to flag up front: overclocked or modified units aren't covered, and that order included the Overclocking Bundle.

The exact warranty terms are being reconciled, so I won't quote you a length. I've pinged the team for the precise terms on your NerdQX. Stay in the chat and someone will jump in, or it comes to your email if you step away.

Is the unit playing up?
I keep blowing fuses

Most likely it's total load on one circuit, not the miner itself. Each NerdQX plus your other units adds up fast, and a 15A breaker tops out around 1400W continuous. Move the QX to its own circuit and see if it holds.

Is it running an overclocked profile? If you've pushed the clocks up, drop it back to stock first, that's where the current spike comes from.
It blows the fuse on the unit

That's a hardware fault, not your wiring. A fuse on the unit going repeatedly usually points at the PSU, and we can replace a PSU on its own without you sending the whole miner back.

Start the RMA here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

One thing I have to ask straight: has that unit been overclocked? Overclocked or modified units aren't covered, and it changes what we can do.
No to overclocked

Good, that keeps you covered. Fill in the RMA form with the order number Shop···· and say the on-unit fuse blows repeatedly, and you'll get a return label. Processing runs up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse.

I've also put it in front of the team with the warranty terms for your QX. Stay in the chat and someone will pick it up here, otherwise it comes to your email.
What do i do now

Two things.

Right now, unplug it and leave it off. A fuse that keeps going is not something to keep resetting.

Then fill in the RMA form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Use order Shop···· and write that the fuse on the unit blows repeatedly, not overclocked. A return label comes back to you.

The team has the warranty side and will confirm here or by email. Anything else while you're here?
